question: Whose guru-line runs Tapana to Motaka, and are his disciples teaching-poor?
premises: up to Tapana-to-Motaka-end, whose is my guru-sequence
inference: Tapana-to-Motaka lineage-holder's disciples never lack teaching.
plain_english: Up to Tapana-to-Motaka-end, whose is my guru-sequence — his, my, of all disciples, no teaching-poverty.
